SELECT m.area_name FROM mining_area_category m WHERE m.level = 1
AND m.is_sealed = 0
AND m.area_name IN
#{n}
ORDER BY COALESCE(m.sequence, m.id)

SELECT COALESCE(sum(s.production_data), 0) as productionData, COALESCE(sum(s.expand_data), 0) as expandData, COALESCE(sum(s.footage_data), 0) as footageData, COALESCE(sum(s.enter_well_num), 0) as enterWellNum, COALESCE(sum(s.come_out_well_num), 0) as comeOutWellNum FROM mine_development_data md JOIN sub_mine_development_data s ON s.mine_development_dataID = md.id WHERE md.unit_name = #{unitName} AND md.record_date = #{recordDate} AND md.is_deleted = 0 and s.unit_nameJSON='合计'

SELECT COALESCE(sum(s.production_data), 0) as productionData, COALESCE(sum(s.expand_data), 0) as expandData, COALESCE(sum(s.footage_data), 0) as footageData, COALESCE(sum(s.enter_well_num), 0) as enterWellNum, COALESCE(sum(s.come_out_well_num), 0) as comeOutWellNum FROM mine_development_data md JOIN sub_mine_development_data s ON s.mine_development_dataID = md.id WHERE md.unit_name = #{unitName} AND md.is_deleted = 0 AND md.record_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} and s.unit_nameJSON='合计'

SELECT sum(production_plan) as productionPlan, sum(production_objective) as productionObjective, sum(exploration_plan) as explorationPlan, sum(exploration_objective) as exploratioObjective, sum(footage_plan) as footagePlan, sum(footage_objective) as footageObjective from coal_mine_working_day where working_month= #{planMonth} and unit_name= #{unitName} and working_days<=#{days}
